# Staff Handling Policies
This SOP covers the standard procedures for hiring, transferring, demoting, dismissing, and otherwise handling staff positions aboard Project Verdant.
This sector is not owned by Nanotrasen or the TSF. Nanotrasen and the TSF are supporting organizations operating alongside Verdant Terra Solutions.
Unless stated otherwise, hiring and transfer processes for VTS personnel are handled through Nanotrasen administrative procedure. The exception is VTS main command, which is handled directly by VTS Central Command.
The TSFO is not required to follow Nanotrasen internal employment guidelines. However, TSFO personnel are still subject to Space Law, VTS guidelines, and all applicable server rules.
Staff handling decisions should be made in good faith and should support station operations, roleplay, and the chain of command.
